subject.title: Memory dreaming run pegs the gateway event loop for ~10 min until killed; short-term recall store can never persist (2026.6.9, reproduces on unmodified dist)

question: Should maintainers require the reporter's process samples or a live current-main reproduction before authorizing a fix PR for this memory-core dreaming event-loop peg?
rationale: The report is strong and reproduces on the latest release, but the current code has multiple plausible hot paths and a source-only repair could target the wrong final-stretch stall.

options.title: Collect samples first
options.body: Ask for or inspect the 2026.6.11 process sample and corpus/config shape, then queue the fix against the confirmed hot path.

options.title: Queue source-only performance work
options.body: Allow a fix PR to add yielding/bounds around the most suspicious current paths, accepting higher risk of missing the reporter's actual stall.

options.title: Fold only observability into crash recovery
options.body: Treat the interruption evidence as input to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97692, but leave the event-loop peg itself unresolved.

recommendation.title: Collect samples first
recommendation.body: Ask for or inspect the 2026.6.11 process sample and corpus/config shape, then queue the fix against the confirmed hot path.

likelyOwner.reason: The central promotion and session-ingestion history points here first, with adjacent review from recent memory-core hardening owners.
